Considering the compatibility between female anthros and humans this was the only way they could survive the coming century.

Anthros from countries around the globe began to mobilize together for a joint strike against the United States, Nuclear weapons we're used quite a few times. As US cities were overran one-by-one. 

Anthros eventually drove the US military back until their inevitable capitulation. After the official surrender on the US on June 19, 2001. After which, no more human women exist.
